title: Entice HP+ (Transom & Sidelites)
description:
Architects kept asking for Entice HP+ with sidelites and transoms, and without them we were losing specifications. On one large government campus, HP+ was the basis of design, and the job went to a competitor because we couldn't support a sidelite.

We developed transom and sidelite framing members that keep HP+'s weather and thermal performance, ran full assembly testing for air, water, structural and racking loads, wrote the installation manuals, and took the program from Gate 0 to Gate 3 in two months.

brief.label: Problem
brief.text: Without sidelites and transoms, HP+ lost projects to competitors whenever an entrance needed them.

brief.label: Solution
brief.text: Transom and sidelite framing members that broaden HP+'s architectural applications while keeping its weather and thermal performance.

brief.label: Customers
brief.text: Primary: mid-size commercial architecture firms that want bold, code-compliant entries. Secondary: glaziers who want a complete entrance from one supplier.

brief.label: Value
brief.text: The complete HP+ entrance: monumental doors with matching transoms and sidelites, without sacrificing performance.

brief.label: Manufacturing
brief.text: Built in-house at CRL's Los Angeles plant and made to order, so no new inventory is held.

brief.label: Competition
brief.text: FHC Aspire, Assa Abloy ThermaGuard, U.S. Aluminum Mojave 250T.

swot.strengths:
Adds sidelites and transoms, closing HP+'s biggest gap
Keeps its industry-leading thermal and weather ratings
Full entrance systems strengthen spec appeal
Built in-house for quality control
swot.weaknesses:
Development and testing investment
Only one assembly tested (door plus one sidelite); broader validation may be needed
Made to order, so availability depends on production capacity
swot.opportunities:
Win back projects that went to competitors
Give architects more freedom without sacrificing performance
Few systems combine premium aesthetics and thermal performance in one package
swot.threats:
Competitors may move quickly to match or undercut
Specifiers may wait for documentation and proof points

my_role: I led this program from Gate 0 to Gate 3 in two months: making the case from lost projects and the open HP+ pipeline, defining the framing members with engineering, coordinating full-assembly testing, and getting installation manuals and SKUs set up for made-to-order production.
